CustomField.description: Group letter of the prerequisite named by Blocked_By_Sequence__c. BLANK MEANS THE SAME GROUP AS THIS ROW, which is true of both live pairs (B3 blocked by B2, I8 blocked by I7). It exists so a future cross-group prerequisite - for example a J-group item blocked by an I-group item - is a definition edit rather than a schema change plus a fan-out rewrite. Ignored when Blocked_By_Sequence__c is blank.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Group letter of the prerequisite item. Leave blank when the prerequisite is in the same group as this row.
CustomField.label: Blocked By Group Letter
